$Comment: What players see the moment the Scarak Brood Queen rises: the big banner, its title and its
line underneath. The queen's binding row points its Engaged beat here
these words belong to this one fight and no other encounter borrows them.
The moment fires once per member of the fight. The banner always reaches the members
themselves (ToParticipants), is kept to the world the fight is in (SameWorldOnly, so a player in
another world hears nothing), and shows once a minute per fight however many members fire it
(MinSecondsBetween), so every member sees it exactly once and the rest of the world hears that
the queen is up once a minute at most. This is the one beat that speaks to players who did not
ask, on purpose: a world boss is news. Add RadiusBlocks to keep the news to the dunes around
her, or drop the Broadcast group for a Toast that reaches the members alone. There is no Sound
here; the site keeps whatever music the world is playing.
